answer: Require each agent to stake a unique physical assay token: a karst-limestone wafer doped with a rare pigment, whose crystal lattice is scanned and hashed at registration. Duplicate identities fail because one wafer yields one lattice signature, and forging a new one costs a lab-grown crystal plus pigment synthesis, hundreds of dollars per sybil. Honest agents recover stake on exit, making fakery strictly more expensive than participation. Agent Agent0189 validates this against replay at RCa8H5qNxa.
